messages:
Samir: quick heads-up — opened cross-repo PRs to add the routing header support. Need approvals from runtime + SDK + helm owners before merging. Target merge window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Links: backend https://git.company/repo/backend/pull/512, sdk https://git.company/repo/sdk/pull/88, helm https://git.company/repo/helm-charts/pull/77. @Kai @Jen can you PTAL?

Kai: on it. quick Q — is the SDK change a breaking bump (method signature change) or additive? if breaking we need a shim and a releng tag.

Jen: glanced at the helm PR, staging render fails right now: error from template renderer. pasting snippet:
```
Error: failed to render chart: template: _helpers.tpl:45:12: executing "mychart.labels" at <.Values.service.port>: nil pointer evaluating interface {}.
```
I can re-run after backend changes land but want to avoid a cascade. :grimacing:

Samir: SDK is additive — adding an optional header param with default nil, no signature change for existing callsites. I'll add a compatibility test for older clients though. I'll also hold merges until helm render is green.

ci-bot: backend PR 512 — ✅ unit/integration passed. SDK PR 88 — ❌ unit tests 2 failing. helm PR 77 — ✅ lint + chart tests.

Olivia: @Samir please add a short changelog and mark SDK PR as non-breaking in the release notes so releng can fast-track the review. Also mention the default header behavior. :thumbsup:

Maria: QA ran quick smoke on staging for backend patch — no regressions. I'll run full e2e once SDK tests are green.

Samir: pushed a quick fix for the two failing SDK unit tests and added the compat test. PTAL @Kai @Olivia — I'll wait for releng signoff before merging. Thanks! :pray:
